prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for ginger tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single small earthy-toned hand-thrown ceramic cup filled with golden-amber ginger tea, placed slightly off-center (upper left). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: three or four fresh ginger root pieces (knobby tan-brown skin with a hint of pale interior where one is sliced), two thin pale-yellow ginger slices showing the radial fiber pattern, one sprig of small green leaves, and a tiny suggestion of warm steam curling from the cup (soft pale wisps, not opaque). The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Ginger root and leaf shapes have clean confident silhouettes, not painterly brushstrokes. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle warm-amber glazed rim. Warm diffuse morning light from upper left casts a faint soft shadow below the cup and ginger pieces. Feels fresh, warming, restorative. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes. Match composition and rendering style of tea-card-chamomile.
